_read_me: Model ids live HERE and nowhere else in the source. A model id scattered
across four modules is four places to miss when one of them changes, and a
silent model change invalidates every comparison made across it -- which
in this project is the difference between evidence and an anecdote.
A change to this file is a reviewable diff on a protected path. The
orchestrator records the resolved model id in every run's metadata.json,
so a past run can be read back against the model that actually produced it
rather than against whatever this file says today.
temperature_note: Zero everywhere. These workers are producing evidence and queue transitions, not prose; run-to-run variation buys nothing here and costs reproducibility.
verification_note: These ids are NOT verified against the providers' current catalogues from inside this checkout -- there is no network here. AUTONOMY_SETUP.md lists checking them as a one-time owner step, and a wrong id surfaces as a named API failure on the first live call, never as a silent fallback to another model.
